mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_no, o.seller_id, o.buyer_id, o.product_id, o.real_price, o.deal_type, o.order_source, o.status, o.pay_status, o.pay_time, o.pickup_place, o.remark, o.expire_time, o.finish_time, o.cancel_reason, o.create_time, p.title as productTitle, p.images as productImages from trade_order o left join product p on o.product_id = p.id where o.id = #{id}
